top_signals.title: Mike Wilson Says Oil Risk to Equities Not Insurmountable
top_signals.summary: Mike Wilson, chief investment officer and chief US equity strategist at Morgan Stanley, discusses how markets have “digested” multiple risks through the year and says the firm is rotating instead of reducing their overall exposure to equities. Wilson also warns about concerns in the short term for stocks related to crude product prices. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
